content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge uses Matthew 1:16's silence on the begetter and the absence of contrary wording as the basis for UNDERDETERMINED.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"UNDERDETERMINED -- the passive egennēthē states no verdict on the begetter in either direction","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.","room":"The phrase 'single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED' was read either as barring silence-based UNDERDETERMINED or as allowing UNDERDETERMINED when neither side's verse states the contrary.","why":"K-S2 expressly forbids treating a single verse's failure to state a link or its contrary as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED."}
